_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Government Industry Data Exchange Program (GIDEP) Alert/Safe-Alert Report
summary: The GIDEP Alert/Safe-Alert Report gives the government information on nonconforming items, supplies, services, or safety problems that have adversely impacted or could impact a Government-funded program.
office_of_primary_responsibility: OS Naval Warfare Assessment Center, P.O. Box 8000, Corona, CA 91718-8000
use_relationship:
The Alert/Safe Alert Report provides the government with information concerning nonconforming items, supplies, and services or safety problems which have adversely impacted, or has potential to adversely impact a Government-funded program(s). This interchange of information will help eliminate instances where individual agencies or their contractors acquire supplies and services previously identified as nonconforming by other agencies.
This data item description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
The GIDEP Operations Manual, S0300-BT-PRO-010 and electronic reporting templates may be obtained from the GIDEP Operations Center or electronically at http://members.gidep.org.
This DID supersedes DI-QCIC-80125A.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference document.
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendment and revision, shall be as reflected in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Alert/Safe Alert shall be presented on DD Form 1938 or electronically.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The Alert/Safe Alert Report shall contain all data specified on DD Form 1938 electronic template in accordance with instructions cited on back side of the form and or the guidance of S0300-BT-PRO-010, Chapter 7.

preparation_instructions.title: Media Requirement.
preparation_instructions.content: The media requirements shall be as specified on the DD Form 1423 CDRL.

preparation_instructions.title: Distribution Statement A:
preparation_instructions.content: Approved for Public release; distribution is unlimited.
